scripts.title: Pulsar
scripts.script:
-- Vela Pulsar Tool (Fixed for Delta Executor)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
tool.Name = "Vela Pulsar"
tool.RequiresHandle = true
tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -1, 0) -- Better grip position

local handle = Instance.new("Part")
handle.Name = "Handle"
handle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
handle.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
handle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
handle.CanCollide = false
handle.Anchored = false
handle.Parent = tool

-- Sound
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://94869200018183"
sound.Looped = true
sound.Volume = 1
sound.Parent = handle

-- Spin on Heartbeat
local connection
tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	sound:Play()
	
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		handle.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(3960 * dt), 0)
	end)
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	sound:Stop()
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
end)

-- Give tool to LocalPlayer
tool.Parent = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

-- Auto re-give if character respawns
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
	character = newChar
	task.wait(1) -- Small delay for Backpack to load
	if not player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Vela Pulsar") then
		tool:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
	end
end)

print("✅ Vela Pulsar loaded successfully!")
